subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Dear Michaela,


I hope you are doing well. 


My name is Sara from Avicenna. We've received your request for a meeting. Thank you very much for your interest in our product and also for sharing this information about your project with us. We'd be happy to help you with your project.


We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. We’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.


You can certainly implement your EMA study in Avicenna and send as many surveys as necessary at your desired time, either on a fixed schedule or in a randomized manner.


In case you are wondering, our pricing depends on three factors:


  1. The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well)
  2. The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study)
  3. The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll


We would be able to provide you with a quote quickly if you share this information about your study with us.


If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts.


We’d love to hop on a quick call to walk you through our platform and learn more about your project. However, we will be traveling for business over the next two weeks and our schedule is somewhat unpredictable. We will be back in the office on October 23rd and can arrange a meeting at your convenience then. I’ve shared our calendar here.

If your timeline is tight, please let us know, and we will do our best to find a suitable time.

Best,

Sara

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com

Please let me know if I need to specify anything more to receive a price estimation.
 
Kind Regards,
Michaela

subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Hi Michaela,

Thank you for sharing the details about your study. We would be happy to discuss your project further in a meeting when convenient for you.

Regarding the motion data, it would be helpful to specify the exact data types you wish to include, as this may affect pricing. Here are some quotes to give you an idea of our pricing range:
  • The total licensing cost to collect survey responses (EMA data) from 100 to 120 participants for the duration of 14 days will be CAD 600.00 (~ 402.15€) to CAD 720.00 (~ 482.59€).
  • If you add pedometer data to your license, for example, the cost will be CAD 1,200.00 (~ 804.31€) to CAD 1,440.00 (~ 965.17€).
  • If you also include accelerometer data, the cost will be CAD 2,400.00 (~ 1,608.62€) to CAD 2,880.00 (~ 1,930.34€).
Please note that there is no limit on rolling enrollment, so you can recruit participants gradually. However, if you want to extend your study for longer than 1 year, an additional 20% will be added to the license fee for each year.

Additionally, we are pleased to offer you a pilot study with 30 participants free of charge to better support your work.

If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Best,
Sara
